description: Unit tests for gzip source stream decoding, including various scenarios such as empty streams, correct gzip data, missing footers, and error conditions, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: GzipSourceStreamTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for gzip source stream unit tests, parameterized by buffer size, read mode, and read result type.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with specified source stream type (GZIP or DEFLATE), prepares source data, compresses it, and creates the gzip source stream.

methods.name: CompleteReadsIfAsync
methods.description: Completes pending asynchronous reads on the mock stream if in async mode, otherwise returns previous result.

methods.name: source_data
methods.description: Returns pointer to source data buffer.

methods.name: encoded_data
methods.description: Returns pointer to encoded (compressed) data buffer.

methods.name: output_buffer
methods.description: Returns the IOBuffer used for reading output data.

methods.name: output_data
methods.description: Returns pointer to output buffer data.

methods.name: output_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns size of the output buffer.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns pointer to the mock source stream.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns pointer to the gzip source stream being tested.

methods.name: ReadStream
methods.description: Reads from the stream until EOF or error, appending data to output string, returning total bytes read or error code.
